upload.localOnlyBody: The upload didn't go through, so your coach can't see this photo yet. It will retry next time you open the app.

update.busyBody: Something is in progress (a workout, timer, check-in or unsaved edit). Its saved progress resumes after the update, but you can also update later — it will install on its own once you're done.
update.busyOtherTab: The app is open in another tab with something in progress (a workout, timer, check-in or unsaved edit). Updating reloads every tab. You can also update later — it will install on its own once that tab is done.

subscription.priceKept: Prefilled from the current term — change it if the price changed.

outbox.waiting: Waiting for a connection — it will send automatically
outbox.keptRetrying: It's kept on this device and will be sent automatically — or tap Retry now.

syncState.failedDetail_other: {{count}} changes couldn't sync — they stay on this device.

you.removeUnverified: We couldn’t check whether everything has synced. Try again when you’re online.
you.removeTitle: Remove your data from this device?
you.removeBody: This signs you out and deletes what Forma stores on this device for your account: workouts, meals, photos and settings. Everything already saved to your account stays with you and your coach and comes back when you sign in again.
you.removeDrafts_one: Your unfinished draft (a check-in or assessment you haven’t sent) is only on this device and will be removed too.
you.removeDrafts_other: Your {{count}} unfinished drafts (check-ins or an assessment you haven’t sent) are only on this device and will be removed too.
you.removedBody: Sign in again any time — your history comes back from your account.
you.removeFailedTitle: Signed out, but some data stayed on this device
you.removeFailedBody: Close other Forma tabs and try again after signing in.
